intro: At this AQI, GRAP Stage {stage} measures apply in Delhi NCR. Check caqm.nic.in for the stage in force.

stages.line: Stage I measures include a citizens charter asking drivers not to idle and to turn the engine off at red lights.

trigger.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage I

source.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage I citizens charter
source.quote: Do not idle your vehicle, also turn off the engine at red lights.

stages.line: Stage II measures include housing societies providing electric heaters to guards and other staff, so that nobody has to burn waste or wood to keep warm.

trigger.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage II

source.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage II actions
source.quote: Resident Welfare Associations to necessarily provide electric heaters to staff engaged in security, sanitation, horticulture and other miscellaneous services to avoid open Bio-Mass/ MSW burning during winters.

stages.line: Stage III measures include hybrid classes, in school and online, for children up to Class V in Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddh Nagar. Families can choose the online option.

trigger.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage III

source.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage III actions
source.quote: mandatorily conduct classes in schools for children up to class V in a "Hybrid" mode i.e., both in physical and online mode (wherever online mode is feasible) [...] The option to exercise the online mode of education, wherever available, shall vest with the students and their guardians.

stages.line: Stage IV measures include a citizens charter asking children, older people and people with lung or heart disease to avoid outdoor activities and stay indoors as much as possible.

trigger.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage IV

source.title: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for the NCR (revision 21.11.2025), Stage IV citizens charter
source.quote: Children, elderly and those with respiratory, cardiovascular, cerebrovascular or other chronic diseases to avoid outdoor activities and stay indoors, as much as possible.
